Report schedules deliver reports, not CI identification.

items.stem: Which TWO are required for the MID Server to discover a Linux host via SSH?

options.text: Valid SSH credentials stored in ServiceNow
options.rationale: Correct: Discovery needs credentials to authenticate to the target.

options.text: Network reachability from the MID Server to the host
options.rationale: Correct: the MID Server must be able to reach the host on the needed ports.
Performance Analytics is unrelated to SSH discovery.
Knowledge articles are irrelevant to discovery.
Catalog items are requestable services, not a discovery prerequisite.
